title: Operational K9 Cardiac Arrest
markdown:
# Operational K9 Cardiac Arrest

![Visual reference from Operational K9 Cardiac Arrest](../../assets/figures/page-0204-visual.webp)

These canine guidelines are reserved for use only on **Operational K9s, who are injured or become ill while on duty, by appropriately trained EMS personnel. Ill or injured humans always take priority over canines.**

### EMT

1. Initiate high-quality chest compressions with minimal interruptions
    a. Compression rate of 100-120 compressions/minute
    b. Depth of 1/3 -1/2 of chest width
    c. Allow for full chest recoil
2. High-flow O2 with BVM ventilation 1 breath every 10 chest compressions during recoil and **without** interrupting compressions **or** at a ratio of 30:2
3. Continue 2-minute cycles of chest compressions with pulse checks
4. Contact emergency veterinary as soon as possible for further guidance
5. If ROSC occurs, refer to K9 Post-Resuscitation Care protocol, **OD Green 12**
6. If no ROSC in 20 minutes and ALS-trained K9 care clinician not on scene, terminate resuscitation.

### ADVANCED EMT

7. If defibrillator available and patient in VF/pulseless VT, shock at 2 J/kg, any subsequent shocks at 4 J/kg.
8. Establish **IV/IO** without interrupting chest compressions
9. Manage the airway per **OD Green 6**. Avoid respiratory rate greater than 10/minute in cardiac arrest

### PARAMEDIC

10. One medication intervention at each 2-minute reassessment per RECOVER clinical guidelines (https://recoverinitiative.org/2024-guidelines/)
11. EPINEPHRine 0.01 mg/kg of 1 mg/10 mL **IV/IO** push every 3-5 minutes
    a. Asystole/PEA: atropine 0.04 mg/kg **IV/IO** push at the initiation of CPR,
    b. VF/VT: lidocaine 2 mg/kg or amiodarone 5 mg/kg **IV/IO** push
12. Consider causes of OHCA:
    a. Is hypovolemia suspected? If yes, give fluid bolus of 20 mL/kg
    b. Is hypoxia suspected? If yes, administer high-flow oxygen and manage airway per **OD Green 6**
    c. Do you suspect a pneumothorax? If yes, perform bilateral needle decompressions, refer to **OD Green 15**
13. Contact veterinarian for further treatment recommendations
14. If achieve ROSC, proceed to **OD Green 12**
